title: PRAY THIS BEFORE SUNRISE AND CANCEL EVERY EVIL APPOINTMENT SET FOR YOUR DAY
text: Put your hand on your chest. Say this, I am covered. I am hidden. I am preserved by the blood that never loses its power. Glory to God. Sit down. Sit down. Sit down. I need to talk to you this morning because the spirit of the Lord woke me up with a burden, not a message, a burden. There's a difference between preaching a message and carrying a burden. When you carry a burden, you don't choose the words, the words carry you. And this morning, I am not the one speaking. I want you to understand that. What flows from this altar today is not Joshua Selman, it is the eternal voice of the one who sits between the cherubim, the one who was and is and is to come, the ancient of days, the first and the last. And he has something to say to you before the sun rises on your day. Before your feet hit the ground this morning, before you open that door, before you step into that Monday, before you walk into that office, before you board that vehicle, God says, "Cancel it." Cancel what the enemy scheduled because the enemy is not passive. He does not sleep. He does not take days off. 1 Peter chapter 5 verse 8 tells us, "Be sober, be vigilant because your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour." Your adversary, not a stranger, not a distant nuisance, your adversary, the one assigned against your specific life, walks about. He's mobile. He's strategic. He's intentional. And if you will not be intentional in prayer before sunrise, he will set appointments that you will keep without knowing you kept them. I said [clears throat] he sets appointments. Are you hearing me? Listen, the word appointment means a scheduled encounter. It means something was arranged. It means a time was fixed, a location was determined, a consequence was designed. And the kingdom of darkness, don't let anybody fool you, has a council. Job chapter 1 verse 6. Now, there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. Satan had access to the council. Satan made a case. Satan set a target. Satan scheduled Job's suffering. But, here's what the enemy forgot about. Job, there was a covering. There was a hedge. And today, by the authority of the name of Jesus, we are restoring every hedge that the enemy has broken around your life. Somebody shout, "Restore it, Lord." I want to show you something in the word. Open your Bible to Proverbs chapter 4 verse 18. I want you to see this. It says, "But, the path of the just is as the shining light that shineth more and more unto the perfect day." The path of the just is a shining light. That means your day Your day was designed by God to shine. Your morning was designed to be illuminated. Your steps were designed to be ordered. Psalm 37 verse 23 says, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he delighted in him." Ordered steps. But, what happens when a man refuses to pray? What happens when a woman skips the altar and goes straight into the day? What happens when the children of God treat prayer like an optional add-on instead of a prophetic weapon? The enemy fills the vacuum. Every space that prayer does not occupy, the enemy occupies. Say that back to me. Every space that prayer does not occupy, the enemy occupies. This is not theology, this is warfare reality. And the Lord told me to gather intercessors and seekers this morning. People who are willing to rise before the world wakes up and declare the outcome of their day before the day declares itself. Because the enemy works in the night watches. Psalm 91:5 says, "Thou shall not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day." There are arrows that fly in the day. Targeted arrows, specific arrows, arrows that have your name written on them, arrows aimed at your marriage, arrows aimed at your children, arrows aimed at your health, arrows aimed at your business. And if you don't pray they land, but I came to tell you you have authority. Luke chapter 10:19 Jesus said, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you. Nothing shall by any means hurt you." That is a covenant statement, that is not a suggestion, that is not a maybe. That is not I hope so, that is the immovable, unshakable word of the living God. And this morning we are going to stand on that word and declare our day from the altar before the sun rises. Touch your neighbor and say, "I'm not going into today unarmed." I want to preach this to you. Isaiah chapter 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. No weapon, not no powerful weapon, not no weapon they try hard with, no weapon formed, that is past tense. It means weapons will be formed. The enemy will try, but the God who formed you before the foundation of the world has already declared the end from the beginning and the end. He has declared over your life is victory. This is why you have to pray. Not to inform God, he knows everything. Not because God is reluctant, he's more willing to bless you than you are to receive the blessing. You pray to enforce what heaven has already decided. Prayer is not a request line. Prayer is an enforcement mechanism. When you pray in the morning before sunrise, you are standing on heaven's verdict and declaring it legally in the earthly realm. You are saying what God has said about my day, I enforce it now. What the enemy has plotted against my day, I cancel it now. Come on, cancel it right now in Jesus' name. Somebody is here and the enemy has been working against your family for three generations. I see it. I see a bloodline curse, something that started in your grandfather's house. Something that was handed down through doors that were opened and every time a child in your family gets to a certain place, a certain age, a certain level, something pulls them back. Something cuts them off. Something destroys the progress. The Lord says it ends today. It ends in this generation. You are the generation of the redeemed. Galatians chapter 3:13, Christ had redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, for it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. He became a curse, so the curse would have no legal right over your lineage. The blood of Jesus speaks better things. Hebrews 12:24, the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. I decree over that bloodline break in Jesus' name. Now, let's go into prayer. I need you to rise. Rise in your spirit if you cannot rise physically. I need you in warfare posture. I need you engaged. This is not a spectator sport. What we are about to do now is surgical. We are going into the heavenly realm. We are standing before the courts of heaven. We are canceling appointments. We are closing doors. We are sealing destinies. We are releasing angels. We are destroying altars. And when we are done, the sun that rises on your life today will rise on a day that has been secured by the blood, backed by the word, and enforced by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Open your mouth, open it wide and say, "Father, I come before you this morning in the name of Jesus. I come covered by the blood. I come by covenant. I come by the mercy of God that is new every morning. Lamentations 3:33 says, "Your mercies are new every morning." So, I receive fresh mercy for this day. I receive fresh grace. I receive fresh anointing. I receive fresh protection. I receive fresh direction. Father, before this day unfolds, I present it to you. I present my morning. I present my afternoon. I present my evening. I present my night. I present every road I will travel. I present every person I will encounter. I present every decision I will make. And I declare that this day belongs to you. Now, warfare. Lift your voice. Every evil appointment set for me today, I cancel you by fire. Every evil arrangement made against my life in the night, I scatter you by the blood of Jesus. Every arrow that was shot into my day before the sun rose, I pull out every arrow by fire. Every trap set on my path, I expose you by the light of the Holy Ghost, and I command you to be dismantled. Every pit dug for my feet today, I command the earth to swallow that pit in Jesus' name. Every ambush assigned against me, I release the angel of the Lord against you now. Psalm 34:7, "The angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and delivered them." I am releasing in angels of God around your life right now. Every angel assigned to your protection, wake up. Every angel assigned to your destiny, arise. Every angel assigned to your breakthrough, move now in Jesus name. I decree angelic covering over my life today. I decree angelic intervention in my affairs. I decree that wherever I go, the host of heaven moves with me. No weapon formed against me shall prosper today. No evil eye shall have power over me today. No witchcraft assignment shall locate me today. No accident shall happen to me today. No sudden calamity shall come near my dwelling today. I am preserved. I am protected. I am hidden under the shadow of the almighty. Psalm 91:1, He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I choose to dwell in the secret place. I choose prayer as my shelter. I choose the word as my shield. I choose the blood as my covering. Now, pray for your family. Father, every evil appointment set for my family today, cancel it by fire. Every assignment against my spouse today, I destroy it now. Every plan against my children, I pull it down by the power in the blood of Jesus. My children shall not be involved in accidents today. My children shall not be victims of violence today. My children shall not fall into wrong hands today. I speak preservation over my children. I speak covering over their schools, their roads, their environment. Every stranger assigned to harm them today, let the angel of the Lord scatter them now. Someone is praying for a child who has gone astray. A child who left the path of righteousness and went into darkness. The Lord says, I heard your prayer in the night watches. I saw your tears on your pillow. I know the name of that child. I know the road they are on and the Lord says I am setting an ambush of grace on their path. Even today, something will happen that will make that child remember who they are. Even today, a door will close that was keeping them in the wrong place. The Lord says your child is coming back. Don't give up. Don't stop praying. Pray it into manifestation right now. Father, I pray for my child who has wandered. Lord, you said in Luke 15 that the father ran to meet the prodigal son while he was yet a great way off. Lord, run to my child today. Set divine interruptions in their path. Let grace ambush them. Let mercy locate them. Let your love pursue them. In the name of Jesus, bring my child back. Now, let's address the altars. I need you to understand something. An altar is a place of agreement. An altar is a place of covenant. An altar is a place where something was exchanged. Some of you, somewhere in your family history, somebody opened a door. Somebody went to a place they shouldn't have gone. Somebody made a covenant they should have never made and that covenant created an altar and that altar has been releasing assignments against your life, your marriage, your finances, your health and you have been fighting the symptoms without addressing the root. Today, we are going to the root. Exodus chapter 20 verse 5 says God visits the iniquity of the fathers unto the children, unto the third and fourth generation. That is not a condemnation. That is a revelation. It tells you why generational patterns exist. But the redemptive counterpart is Ezekiel chapter 18 verse 20. The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father. Neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. In Christ, the generational debt has been cancelled. In Christ, every ancestral altar loses its legal right. Pray this with me right now. Pray it loud. I stand in the gap for my bloodline. I repent for every sin committed by my ancestors that opened the door. I repent for every covenant made with darkness that brought curses upon my family. I come against every ancestral altar erected in the name of my family. I come against every evil dedication made over my life before my birth. I come against every initiation and every dark covenant that was entered on behalf of my destiny. I plead the blood of Jesus over every altar. I plead the blood of Jesus over every covenant. And by the authority of the name that is above every name, I declare those altars destroyed. Fire. Fire. Fire. I call fire upon every ancestral altar assigned against my family. I call fire upon every witchcraft altar that has been erected to monitor my progress. I call fire upon every marine altar working against my marriage. I call fire upon every satanic council that has been meeting over my finances. Let fire fall now. Now I hear the spirit of God saying someone has been experiencing mysterious losses. You work, you earn, but somehow the money disappears and you cannot account for where it went. There is a hole, and that hole is not natural, it is supernatural. Haggai chapter 1 verse 6, "Ye have sown much and bring in little. Ye eat, but ye have not enough. Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you, but there is none warm." "And he that earneth wages, earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes." This is a covenantal pattern of financial frustration. It is not your incompetence. It is a spiritual assignment. The Lord says the hole is being closed today. Pray this. Every hole in my financial life be sealed by the blood of Jesus. Every devourer assigned to my harvest, I command you to release what you have swallowed. Malachi 3:11 says the Lord will rebuke the devourer for my sake. So, Lord, rebuke every devourer attacking my finances today. Every spirit of poverty and lack assigned to my bloodline, I serve you notice of eviction by the authority of the word of God. I am redeemed from the curse of poverty. Deuteronomy 28:12 says the Lord shall open unto me his good treasure. I call it open now. I call blessings from the north, south, east, and west into my financial life. I am a lender and not a borrower. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. And every satanic program working to make me a tail, I destroy it today in Jesus' name. Hallelujah. Now, let's go into healing. I know there are bodies here that have been fighting battles. There are people here who have been told things that frighten them. There are reports that came back and they were not good reports. There are pains that have been in bodies that should not be there. There are growths that appeared, things that were not there before. The Lord sees every one of you. Isaiah chapter 53:5, but he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him. And with his stripes, we are healed. With his stripes, we are healed. Past tense, accomplished, finished. The healing has already been paid for. The only thing that is required now is for you to receive it by faith and enforce it in prayer. Pray for your body. I speak to every organ in my body come into divine alignment. I speak to every cell in my body be renewed by the resurrection power of Jesus Christ. I speak to my blood be purified. I speak to my bones be strengthened. Every cancerous growth in my body I curse you at the root and I command you to dry up and die in Jesus' name. Every tumor dissolve. Every blockage in my blood vessels be cleared. Every inflammation subside. Every infection receive the fire of the Holy Ghost and burn out. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians 6:19 and I decree that no sickness shall dwell in the temple of the Most High. I am healed. I am whole. I am restored. Now let's go into marriage. There are marriages that have been under siege. There are homes that the enemy has been attacking. There is strife where there should be peace. There is [music] distance where there should be intimacy. There are words that have been spoken that should never have been spoken and the enemy has been using those wounds to slowly dismantle what God joined together. But Matthew chapter 19:6 says, "What therefore God had joined together, let not man put asunder. Let not man. Let not the devil. Let not offense. Let not misunderstanding. Let not a third party. Let not finances. Let not distance. What God joins stays joined and today we are reinforcing the covenant of your marriage in the fire of prayer. Every spirit of strife in my marriage, COME OUT. EVERY ROOT of bitterness, Hebrews 12:15 says it defiles many. I uproot every root of bitterness from my marriage. Every third party assigned to destroy my home, I scatter you now. Every strange woman, every strange man sent as a weapon against my covenant, I expose you and I chase you away with fire. Lord, heal my marriage, restore the joy, restore the friendship, restore the love, restore the vision. Let my home be a sanctuary, a place where your presence dwells and the enemy has no access. I hear the Lord saying to someone you have been considering walking away. You have been looking at the situation and saying it is over and the Lord says it is not over. It is not over until the Lord says it is over and the Lord has not given up on your marriage. The Lord says one more prayer, one more night on your knees, one more cry before the altar and watch what I will do. Watch how suddenly I will show up. Watch how the heart that was hard will be softened. Watch how the one who walked away will turn around. I am the God of the impossible. Nothing is too hard for me. Pray one more time for your marriage. Give me one more yes. Lord, I give you my marriage one more time. I refuse to give up. I refuse to accept the enemy's conclusion over my home. Lord, do what only you can do. Move in my spouse's heart. Move in my heart. Heal us, restore us and let the testimony of our marriage be a sign and wonder to this generation. Now, let's deal with destiny. Some people have been delayed. They should be farther than where they are. There is a gap between where God said they would be and where they currently are. And the enemy created that gap through warfare, through wrong connections, through seasons of destruction, through doors that were shut prematurely. The Lord says, "I am closing the gap. Every year stolen from my destiny, I recover it now." Joel chapter 2 verse 25. The Lord says he will restore the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm, the caterpillar, and the palmerworm. Lord, restore my stolen years today. Every opportunity that was stolen from me, I claim it back. Every door that was closed prematurely over my destiny, let it open now. Every vision that was buried, let it resurrect. Every gift that was suppressed, let it arise. Every talent that was stolen or misused, Lord, restore it and multiply it. I see destinies being rerouted. I see the hand of God reaching into situations that have been stuck and releasing them. I see things that have been delayed for years beginning to move in one day. One phone call, one conversation, one divine connection, one open door. It's happening. It's happening for you. It's happening now. Every satanic roadblock on the path of my destiny be destroyed. Every wall that the enemy built to hem me in fall. Every ceiling that was placed over my progress shatter. Every limitation assigned to my life be lifted. I am an eagle. Isaiah 40, verse 31 says, "They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles." And I declare today that no eagle was designed to be caged. I rise above every limitation. I rise above every assignment. I rise into the fullness of what God ordained for my life. Now, I want to speak to the season. There are people who are in transitions right now. You left one thing and you haven't yet arrived at the next thing. And in that in-between space, the enemy is trying to use fear, confusion, and delay to make you think you made a wrong turn. The The says you are on the right road. The fact that it's dark doesn't mean you're going the wrong way. The fact that it's narrow doesn't mean you're going the wrong way. The fact that it feels like nobody understands your journey doesn't mean you're going the wrong way. Jeremiah chapter 29 verse 11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you," said the Lord, "thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end, an expected end." God already knows how it ends and the end he has planned for you is not shame, it is not failure, it is not defeat, it is an expected end of peace, of establishment, of testimony. Hold on. Don't stop in the middle of the transition, you are almost there. Father, I receive grace for this transition. I receive clarity for this season. I receive patience to wait on your timing without losing my faith. I declare [music] that this wilderness is producing something in me. I declare that this delay has a divine purpose. And I declare that when I arrive at my expected end, the testimony will be worth every night I spent in prayer, every morning I rose before sunrise, every hour I invested in the altar. Lord, I trust you with this season. I trust you with my process. Now, let's break every witchcraft assignment. I need you to understand witchcraft is real. It is organized, it is targeted, and some of what you have been experiencing has not been natural. The strange dreams, the repeated failures at the point of breakthrough, the sudden sicknesses that have no medical explanation, the relationships that collapse without reason, the heaviness you feel without cause. >> [music] >> These are not coincidences. These are assignments. But Revelation chapter 12 verse 11 says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they loved not their lives onto the death, the blood overcomes. The testimony enforces. And the believer who understands their authority works in dominion. I come against every witchcraft assignment sent against my life. I come against every monitoring spirit assigned to watch my movements. I come against every witch and wizard that has been gathered in council against my destiny. I send confusion into their ranks by the authority of the name of Jesus. Let every witchcraft prayer [singing and music] prayed against me backfire now. Let every satanic altar burning against me be consumed by fire. Let every evil word spoken against my life be reversed. Let every curse released against me be broken. And let the senders receive the recompense of their deeds in Jesus' name. I decree every satanic surveillance over your life, I blind it today. Every evil eye monitoring your progress, I blind it with the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every satanic agent sent into your neighborhood, your workplace, your family, I expose them and scatter them by the word of the living God. Let every agent of darkness assigned to my location be scattered. Let every Judas in my circle be exposed and removed. Lord, give me discernment to know who is for me and who is a weapon against me. Let divine wisdom lead me in every relationship. Let no man be able to use me for their satanic agenda. I am hidden in the secret place. I am covered by the blood and the enemy has no access to me today. Now receive this, receive it deeply. There is going to be a divine encounter today. For some of you it will be in the morning, for some it will be at noon. For some of you, it will be when you least expect it. The Lord is going to show up in the middle of your ordinary day and do something extraordinary. A word will come to you. A door will open. A provision will arrive. A healing will manifest. A breakthrough will come that you cannot explain. And when it happens, you will know it was the Lord. Father, I position myself for divine encounter today. I open my eyes to see what you are doing. I open my ears to hear what you are saying. I open my hands to receive what you are giving. Let this be a day of testimony. Let this be a day of miracle. Let this be a day that I will never forget. Let this be a day when the enemy's plans become my stepping stones. Lord, show up today in a way that leaves no doubt that it was you. Let me bring this into a final charge. Ephesians chapter 6:13 says, "Wherefore take on to you the whole armor of God that you may be able to withstand in the evil day and having done all to stand. Having done all, stand. The armor is not for retreat. The armor is for standing. And what you have done in this prayer this morning is you have put on the armor. You have taken up the weapons. You have positioned yourself under the blood. You have enforced the word. You have canceled the appointments of the enemy. And now you stand. You don't go into this day afraid. You don't go into this day timid. You don't go into this day wondering if the enemy will win. You go in as a soldier who has already fought and won before the battle began. Because you prayed before sunrise, you canceled it before it could manifest. You sealed your day with the blood before the sun rose on it. This is what the intercessors understand. This is what the warriors know. Prayer before sunrise is not discipline, it is dominion. It is you saying to the kingdom of darkness, "I know you have a plan for my day, but I know the God who holds my day, and his plan for me is greater than your plan against me. Final decrees, say this with me and say them with everything you have. My day is blessed. My morning is secure. My afternoon is covered. My evening is established. Every evil appointment for today, I cancel it by fire. Every plan against my life today, I destroy it now. Every arrow shot into my future, I pull it out. EVERY TRAP SET on my path, I dismantle it. Every word spoken against me today, I reverse it. Every satanic gathering convened against my destiny, I scatter it. I go into this day in the armor of God. I go in with the sword of the spirit. I go in under angelic cover. I go in with the blood of Jesus as my banner. I go in as more than a conqueror. Romans 8:37, because he that is in me is greater than he that is in the world. And I declare that the end of this day will testify of the faithfulness of God. By evening, I will have a testimony. By evening, the enemy will know he picked the wrong person to attack. And by evening, my praise [music] will be a weapon of warfare that dismantles every remaining satanic agenda against my life. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, your day is sealed. Your family is covered. Your marriage is secure. Your health is restored. Your finances are released. Your destiny is enforced. Your morning is won. Go into this day, child of God. Go with boldness. Go with fire. Go knowing that before the sun rose on your day, you rose before the sun, and you dealt with everything the enemy was planning. Receive the benediction of the Lord. Numbers chapter 6, verses 24 to 26. The Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace. Peace, shalom. Completeness in every area. That is what follows a praying person. Go and be a sign and a wonder. Go and carry the fire. And when the testimony comes, come back and give God the glory. In Jesus mighty name it is done. Amen and amen.
